title: Octokit logs an upstream error message unredacted during the App JWT clock-skew retry
resolution: Both Octokit clients get a logger that discards everything; a test captures console and stdio during the clock skew retry.

title: A refresh overtaken by a revocation loses its new token when its cleanup revocation fails
resolution: A revocation waits for pending refreshes, whose tokens join the versions, so it ends them or fails unavailable for a retry.

title: A rejected or malformed token grant is forgotten when its cleanup revocation fails or is skipped
resolution: A token is read apart from its grant; a refused or malformed answer's token is revoked, or kept and revoked before the next call.

title: Ensuring merge protection drops existing required reviews, push restrictions, and strict checks
resolution: Per coordinator decision D2 the protection is read first; any setting the PUT would drop or weaken fails precondition-failed unwritten.

title: Grant validation accepts GitHub permissions beyond the requested ones
resolution: The raw App permission map must equal the request apart from metadata read; extra statuses or administration write is refused.

title: A refresh can return the same expiry as the previous version, not a later one
resolution: A refresh whose expiry is not later than the newest version's is revoked and fails unavailable; tested in one emulated second.

title: An unconfirmed token revocation maps to other codes than unavailable
resolution: Every revocation answer other than success or 401 maps to unavailable and keeps the token; table test of 403, 404, 422, 500.

title: Remote URL validation misses the length, IPv6 literal, and port rules of the contract
resolution: Remote URLs are checked against the execution wire RemoteUrl pattern and its 2048 character bound, with IPv6 and port 0 tests.

title: A refresh in the same second as the previous mint fails unavailable, which real GitHub makes the common case
resolution: A token no later is revoked, the plugin waits the shortfall plus a second through an injected clock and mints once more; emulator step now 0.

title: Every mint pages through all repositories of the installation and compares names case-sensitively
resolution: The installation is listed only after GitHub refuses a mint with 422; names match regardless of case, another owner fails not-found.

title: Credentials never revoked keep their expired tokens and entries in memory for the process lifetime
resolution: Each operation ends versions a minute past expiry without GitHub and forgets credentials whose versions all ended.

title: An operator change between the protection read and write is overwritten
resolution: The window is recorded in design decision 4 and contract section 4; GitHub has no conditional protection write.

title: The factory throws instead of failing invalid for empty App settings
resolution: Empty App ID, installation ID, or private key fail invalid before Octokit is built.

title: A local signing failure is reported as GitHub unavailable
resolution: An error without an HTTP status maps to internal with a message saying the request never reached GitHub.

title: The refresh unavailable cause is missing from the source control contract
resolution: Contract rule 5 and the GitHub refresh row name the no later expiry cause of unavailable.

title: Verified deliveries without a repository, such as ping, fail invalid and the limit is unrecorded
resolution: Design decision 5 records the limit and that the 20e receiver must answer ping without the port.

title: Ensuring merge protection writes even when the current protection already matches
resolution: A protection that already requires exactly the contexts with enforce_admins is returned without a write.
